partyFields.label: Print Name
partyFields.description: full name of the person signing

partyFields.label: Title
partyFields.description: job title of the person signing

partyFields.label: Notice Address
partyFields.description: email or postal address for legal notices

additionalWarranties.label: Additional Warranties
additionalWarranties.description: any warranties beyond the standard terms (often none)

agreement.label: Agreement
agreement.description: the main agreement this document supplements, e.g. "Cloud Service Agreement dated 2026-01-15"

approvedSubprocessors.label: Approved Subprocessors
approvedSubprocessors.description: subprocessors the provider may use, or a link to the list

brandGuidelines.label: Brand Guidelines
brandGuidelines.description: brand guidelines each party must follow, or a link to them

breachNotificationPeriod.label: Breach Notification Period
breachNotificationPeriod.description: how quickly the provider must report a breach, e.g. "10 days"

categoriesOfDataSubjects.label: Categories of Data Subjects
categoriesOfDataSubjects.description: whose personal data is processed, e.g. "customer's employees and end users"

categoriesOfPersonalData.label: Categories of Personal Data
categoriesOfPersonalData.description: kinds of personal data processed, e.g. "names, email addresses"

chosenCourts.label: Chosen Courts
chosenCourts.description: city or county and state of the courts, e.g. "courts located in New Castle, DE"

companyCoveredClaims.label: Company Covered Claims
companyCoveredClaims.description: claims the company must defend the partner against

customerCoveredClaims.label: Customer Covered Claims
customerCoveredClaims.description: claims the customer must defend the provider against

customerObligations.label: Customer Obligations
customerObligations.description: what the customer must provide for the services, e.g. access or materials

customerPolicies.label: Customer Policies
customerPolicies.description: customer policies the provider must follow on site or on its systems

deletionProcedure.label: Deletion Procedure
deletionProcedure.description: how the customer removes the software when the license ends

deliverables.label: Deliverables
deliverables.description: what the provider will deliver under the statement of work

dpa.label: DPA
dpa.description: the data processing agreement that applies, if any

durationOfProcessing.label: Duration of Processing
durationOfProcessing.description: how long personal data is processed, e.g. "for the term of the Agreement"

endDate.label: End Date
endDate.description: when the partnership ends, e.g. a date or "2 years after the Effective Date"

frequencyOfTransfer.label: Frequency of Transfer
frequencyOfTransfer.description: how often personal data is transferred, e.g. "continuous"

generalCapAmount.label: General Cap Amount
generalCapAmount.description: the general liability cap, e.g. "fees paid in the prior 12 months" or "$50,000"

governingLaw.label: Governing Law
governingLaw.description: the US state whose laws govern, e.g. "Delaware"

governingMemberState.label: Governing Member State
governingMemberState.description: the EU member state whose law governs the Standard Contractual Clauses, e.g. "Ireland"

improvementRestrictions.label: Improvement Restrictions
improvementRestrictions.description: limits on using inputs and outputs to improve the AI system (often none)

increasedCapAmount.label: Increased Cap Amount
increasedCapAmount.description: the higher liability cap for Increased Claims

increasedClaims.label: Increased Claims
increasedClaims.description: claims subject to the Increased Cap Amount, e.g. "breach of data protection obligations"

insuranceMinimums.label: Insurance Minimums
insuranceMinimums.description: insurance the provider must carry, e.g. "$1M general liability"

licenseLimits.label: License Limits
licenseLimits.description: limits on the license, e.g. number of users, seats or devices

limitations.label: Limitations
limitations.description: restrictions on offshoring, de-identifying or aggregating PHI (often none)

mndaTerm.label: MNDA Term
mndaTerm.description: years the MNDA lasts from the Effective Date

modifications.label: MNDA Modifications
modifications.description: any changes to the standard MNDA terms (often none)

natureAndPurposeOfProcessing.label: Nature and Purpose of Processing
natureAndPurposeOfProcessing.description: why and how the provider processes personal data

nonRenewalNoticeDate.label: Non-Renewal Notice Date
nonRenewalNoticeDate.description: how far ahead a party must say it won't renew, e.g. "30 days before the end of the Subscription Period"

obligations.label: Obligations
obligations.description: what each party will do in the partnership, e.g. referrals or co-marketing

orderDate.label: Order Date
orderDate.description: the date of the order form

partnerCoveredClaims.label: Partner Covered Claims
partnerCoveredClaims.description: claims the partner must defend the company against

paymentPeriod.label: Payment Period
paymentPeriod.description: time to pay each invoice, e.g. "30 days"

paymentProcess.label: Payment Process
paymentProcess.description: how fees are invoiced and paid

paymentSchedule.label: Payment Schedule
paymentSchedule.description: when payments between the parties are made

permittedUses.label: Permitted Uses
permittedUses.description: what the customer may use the software for

pilotPeriod.label: Pilot Period
pilotPeriod.description: how long the pilot lasts, e.g. "60 days"

program.label: Program
program.description: the design partner program: the product and what the partner will do

providerCoveredClaims.label: Provider Covered Claims
providerCoveredClaims.description: claims the provider must defend the customer against, e.g. IP infringement

providerSecurityContact.label: Provider Security Contact
providerSecurityContact.description: who to contact about security incidents

purpose.label: Purpose
purpose.default: Evaluating whether to enter into a business relationship with the other party.
purpose.description: how Confidential Information may be used

rejectionPeriod.label: Rejection Period
rejectionPeriod.description: time the customer has to reject a deliverable, e.g. "10 days"

responseTimeCredit.label: Response Time Credit
responseTimeCredit.description: service credit when support misses the Target Response Time

resubmissionPeriod.label: Resubmission Period
resubmissionPeriod.description: time the provider has to fix a rejected deliverable

scheduledDowntime.label: Scheduled Downtime
scheduledDowntime.description: planned maintenance windows excluded from uptime

securityPolicy.label: Security Policy
securityPolicy.description: the provider's security policy, or a link to it

sowTerm.label: SOW Term
sowTerm.description: how long each statement of work lasts

specialCategoryData.label: Special Category Data
specialCategoryData.description: any sensitive personal data processed (often none)

specialCategoryDataRestrictions.label: Special Category Data Restrictions or Safeguards
specialCategoryDataRestrictions.description: extra safeguards for special category data

subscriptionPeriod.label: Subscription Period
subscriptionPeriod.description: length of the subscription, e.g. "1 year"

supportChannel.label: Support Channel
supportChannel.description: where support requests are sent, e.g. an email address

targetResponseTime.label: Target Response Time
targetResponseTime.description: support response target, e.g. "1 business day"

technicalSupport.label: Technical Support
technicalSupport.description: the support the provider offers, e.g. hours and channels

term.label: Term
term.description: how long the agreement lasts, e.g. "6 months"

territory.label: Territory
territory.description: where the partnership applies, e.g. "United States"

timeOfAssignment.label: Time of Assignment
timeOfAssignment.description: when ownership of deliverables passes to the customer, e.g. "on payment"

trainingData.label: Training Data
trainingData.description: customer data the provider may use to train AI models (or "none")

trainingPurposes.label: Training Purposes
trainingPurposes.description: what training is allowed for, e.g. "improving the AI System for Customer only"

trainingRestrictions.label: Training Restrictions
trainingRestrictions.description: limits on training, e.g. "no training on personal data"

unlimitedClaims.label: Unlimited Claims
unlimitedClaims.description: claims with no liability cap, e.g. "breach of confidentiality"

uptimeCredit.label: Uptime Credit
uptimeCredit.description: service credit when uptime falls below target, e.g. "10% of monthly fees"

warrantyPeriod.label: Warranty Period
warrantyPeriod.description: how long the software warranty lasts, e.g. "90 days"

documents.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
documents.description: Two parties sharing confidential information with each other, e.g. before exploring a deal.

documents.name: Cloud Service Agreement
documents.description: Providing a SaaS or cloud product to a customer on a subscription.

documents.name: Software License Agreement
documents.description: Licensing installable or on-premise software to a customer.

documents.name: Professional Services Agreement
documents.description: Services such as consulting or implementation delivered under statements of work.

documents.name: Service Level Agreement
documents.description: Uptime targets, support response times and service credits for a cloud service.

documents.name: Data Processing Agreement
documents.description: How a provider processes a customer's personal data (GDPR-style DPA).

documents.name: Business Associate Agreement
documents.description: Handling protected health information (PHI) under HIPAA.

documents.name: AI Addendum
documents.description: Terms for a provider's AI features: inputs and outputs, usage restrictions and model training.

documents.name: Pilot Agreement
documents.description: A short trial of a product before a full commercial deal.

documents.name: Design Partner Agreement
documents.description: Early access to a product in exchange for feedback.

documents.name: Partnership Agreement
documents.description: Business partnerships such as referral, reseller or co-marketing arrangements.
